Your two Magic Miner 40Ts still ship November 14. At $799 for 40 TH/s, they're the best value per TH we sell, which is why the batch sold out as a pre-sale. Is it the date, or something else?
I need the money

I understand. Before you decide, two things.

Cancelling an unshipped pre-sale order carries a 10% restocking fee, so you wouldn't get the full amount back. Keeping the order costs you nothing.

If it helps, keep the order and I'll put a $50 credit back on your card for the wait. It lands within 3 to 5 business days, and your two miners still ship November 14.

Another option is to cancel just one of the two miners, so some money comes back to you and you still keep one. Would either of those work?
